buildSteps: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends postgresql-17 postgresql-17-pgvector curl ca-certificates jq && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

set -e; R=https://ghcr.io/v2/thek3nsai/ops-brain; T=$(curl -fsS 'https://ghcr.io/token?scope=repository:thek3nsai/ops-brain:pull' | jq -r .token); A="Authorization: Bearer $T"; M=$(curl -fsSL -H "$A" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json' $R/manifests/latest | jq -r 'first(.manifests[] | select(.platform.os == "linux" and .platform.architecture == "amd64") | .digest)'); curl -fsSL -H "$A" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json' -o /tmp/m.json $R/manifests/$M; echo "${M#sha256:}  /tmp/m.json" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null; for L in $(jq -r '.layers | reverse | .[].digest' /tmp/m.json); do curl -fsSL -H "$A" -o /tmp/l.tgz $R/blobs/$L; echo "${L#sha256:}  /tmp/l.tgz" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null; if tar -xzf /tmp/l.tgz -C /tmp app/ops-brain 2>/dev/null; then echo "ops-brain from $L" >&2; break; fi; done; install -m 755 /tmp/app/ops-brain /usr/local/bin/ops-brain; rm -rf /tmp/m.json /tmp/l.tgz /tmp/app
